sourceSystem.description: Indicates the source system from which this canonical is imported

timestamp.description: Indicates the timestamp of the canonical in source system

sourcesId.description: Id of the {@link Sources} for the Source

itemStorageLocation.description: The item storage location to which this initial inventory balance series corresponds.

itemFacility.description: The item facility to which this initial inventory balance series corresponds.

partNumber.description: The part number for the part being processed.

description.description: The description for the part.  Ideally under 255 characters.

supplier.description: The supplier for the part. This should be a human readable string, and not a supplier code.

cost.description: The most recent known cost for the part.

name.description: A human readable version of the name for this part.

interval.description: The optional setting for the interval at which to normalize the series.

treatment.description: The optional setting for the treatment to use when normalizing the series.
